# ApexUse — Computer Use MCP Server (apexuse-mcp)

> ApexUse is a local-first, open-source Computer Use MCP server (v0.3.0) written in pure Rust and native OS APIs for macOS (`arm64` & `x86_64`), Windows (`x86_64`), and Linux (`x86_64`). Gives AI coding agents (Antigravity, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, OpenCode) AX-first batched Accessibility inspection with incremental diffing (`state_mode`), single-round-trip inline `return_state: "diff"`, AX-only `verify_mode: "ax"`, Set-of-Mark (`[m1]..[mN]`) visual grounding, native `set_value`/`select_text`, semantic `target` lookup, `keep_snapshot` form-ref reuse, default compact JPEG screenshots, batched `run_actions` (up to 24 steps), local `wait_for` polling, an independent floating `AgentCursor`, and workflow memory over MCP stdio with zero external Rust or npm dependencies.

## Core MCP Tools (`apexuse-mcp`)

- `inspect_app`: AX-first read-only snapshot (`e1..eN` refs, `URL=`, Chrome/Electron table/tab structure, workflow hints) without taking a screenshot. Omits `@(x,y,wxh)` by default (`include_bounds: false`) and auto-diffs repeat calls (`diff: true` -> `state_mode: "full" | "diff" | "unchanged" | "filtered"`).
- `visual_inspect`: Captures window or `"desktop"`, fuses Accessibility + OCR (`ocr="auto"|"fast"|"accurate"|"off"`), overlays `[m1]..[mN]` badges, and returns annotated JPEG (`format="jpeg"`, `quality=80`, `max_width=1280` default) or opt-in PNG (`format="png"`) + mark index.
- `computer`: `inspect` (`diff`, `include_bounds`, `window`, `query`), `click`, `double_click`, `right_click`, `hover`, `drag`, `type`, `set_value` (direct native text write/clear on verified editable fields; `text=""` clears, fails closed on unverified coordinates/OCR-only marks), `select_text` (optional `start`/`end`), `press_key`, target-scoped `scroll` (`ref`/`mark`/`x,y`), `run_actions` (up to 24 chained steps including inline `set_value`, `select_text`, `wait_for`, `inspect`, `target`, and per-step `verify_mode`/`diff`/`include_bounds`), `wait_for` (local AX/OCR poll up to 60s), `confirm`; supports `return_state="none"|"diff"|"full"` (attaches post-action AX state inline and keeps new refs live in 1 round-trip), `include_bounds`, `verify_mode="auto"|"ax"|"visual"` (`"ax"` skips screenshots), `target: { query, role?, fresh? }`, `keep_snapshot`, `verify_change`, `max_retries`, `settle_ms`, `poll_interval_ms`, `retry_delay_ms`, `require_change`.
- `desktop`: `list_applications`, `launch_application`, `activate_application`, `open_url`, `visual_click`, `double_click`, `right_click`, `hover`, `drag` (supports `mark`, `ref`, `target`, or `x`/`y`, plus `return_state`, `include_bounds`, `verify_mode`, and `verify_change`).
- `screenshot`: Unannotated JPEG (default) or PNG window capture after safety preflight.
- `workflow_memory`: Non-secret structural macro recording and parameterized replay (`list`, `lookup`, `record`, `replay`, `clear`).

## OS Architecture

- macOS 14+ (`rust/native/macos_bridge.m`): Batched `AXUIElementCopyMultipleAttributeValues` IPC (`kAXURLAttribute` `URL=`, Chromium/Electron `AXTable`/`AXRow`/`AXCell`/`AXColumnHeader`/`AXTab`, `set_value`/`select_text`), `ScreenCaptureKit` (with resolution cap & 1500ms window cache), Apple `Vision` OCR, `ApexUseCursorView` overlay, per-PID `CGEvent`/`NSEvent` chunked Unicode typing, and host-aware AppKit permission onboarding (`onboard` / `doctor --onboard` with System Settings deep-links and live child-`doctor` Screen Recording polling). Live verified.
- Windows 10/11 (`rust/src/driver/windows.rs`): Pure-Rust Win32 FFI (`IUIAutomation` COM `ValuePattern`/`TextPattern`, `PrintWindow`/`BitBlt`, WinRT `Windows.Media.Ocr`, batched `SendInput`, layered `AgentCursor`, `som_png` codec). Cross-checked; CI build configured.
- Linux X11/Wayland (`rust/src/driver/linux.rs`): Runtime `dlopen` `libX11` / `libXtst`, `AT-SPI2` (`EditableText` / `Text` / `gi.repository.Atspi`), Wayland helpers (`grim`/`spectacle`/`gnome-screenshot`, `wtype`/`ydotool`), `tesseract` OCR, `som_png` codec. Cross-checked; CI build configured.

## Install, Wire & CLI

```sh
npx -y apexuse-mcp install all --write --npx --with-skill --probe
npx -y apexuse-mcp install codex-plugin --write --npx --probe
npx -y apexuse-mcp probe --npx
npx -y apexuse-mcp doctor --onboard
npx -y apexuse-mcp doctor --check
npx skills add Jackpkn/apexuse -g -a codex --skill apexuse -y
npx -y apexuse-mcp config show
npx -y apexuse-mcp call inspect_app --args '{"app":"Calculator"}'
cargo install apexuse-mcp
cargo build --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml
cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml
```

- `npm install` (`npm/apexuse-mcp/scripts/postinstall.js`) prints platform-aware setup commands (`doctor --onboard` on macOS, `doctor --check` elsewhere, `install all ... --probe`, `install codex-plugin`, and `mcpServers` JSON).
- `install all --write` preserves active `codex-plugin` (`[plugins."apexuse@apexuse-local"].enabled = true`) instead of overwriting with `[mcp_servers.apexuse]`; explicit `install codex --write` switches back cleanly (`enabled = false`).
- `probe` / `--probe` (`rust/src/probe.rs`) runs a bounded pure-Rust MCP stdio handshake (`initialize`, `notifications/initialized`, `tools/list`) against the resolved invocation.
